title: St. Joseph's Episcopal Church to host Christmas events | Around The Web | wvnews.com
text:
MCDONOUGH — St. Joseph’s Episcopal Church in McDonough is hosting Christmas events in December.
On Sunday, Dec. 7 at 3 p.m., the church will have a “Holiday Afternoon”.
Starting at 3 p.m., St. Joseph’s organist Friedemann Stihler will play a “Rockin’ Organ Christmas” concert. The concert will include arrangements combining different styles of Christmas music and different styles of rock music.
The choir will sing some special arrangements as well.
At 3:45 p.m., the church will host “Cookies, Cocoa and Caroling” in the parish hall.
“It’s a chance to really get into the Christmas spirit,” said the Rev. Ann Barker. “Sip warm cocoa, decorate cookies and sing favorite carols. The event will be fun for the whole family.”
On Dec. 21 at 6 p.m., the church will hold a “Blue Christmas” service.
A Blue Christmas service is a time when people who are feeling sad around the holidays can come together and draw strength from one another.
“There will be prayers and readings and an opportunity to light a candle to remember loved ones. It is a beautiful service — a time of remembering and peace,” said Barker.
———
For more information visit www.stjosephsmcdonough.org or call the church office at 770-957-7517. The church is at 1865 Ga. Highway 20 East, McDonough.
